newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures easier in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures easier in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were weaker in after-hours trade on Thursday on sporadic selling pressure, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.4 yen per kg lower from the day's close. Benchmark June was off 0.4 yen at 145.2 yen. Volume was 3,404 lots.
During the day prices were trapped within tight ranges, as the yen's fall offset an easing in overseas markets.
"Recent static prices have thinned volume," one trader said.
